name: me-os

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server run migrate:prod && STATIC_DIR=../client/dist npm --prefix server run start

description: Me-OS: a simple operating system for a person. Your day, projects, notes and focus time, kept on your own computer.
